page.overview:
Who is Himawari Uzumaki?

Himawari is the second and youngest child of Naruto and Hinata Uzumaki, born six years after the Fourth Shinobi World War and two years after her brother, Boruto. As her parents continued to stay close to their own childhood friends, she ultimately got to know the kids of her parents' respective friends very well.

On the day that Naruto was to be inaugurated as the Seventh Hokage, Himawari wanted to bring her panda toy to the ceremony, but Boruto, fearing that he would end up carrying it, tried to take it away from her. When the toy's head was ripped off in the ensuing tug-of-war, Himawari awoke her Byakugan and attacked Boruto in her anger, despite his vehement apologies. Naruto, sensing her killing intent, arrived and shielded Boruto, though he was knocked out in the process. Fearful of what an attack that could defeat his father would do to him, Boruto tried to run from Himawari, but she quickly located her brother hiding in a closet. From then on, he vowed to never anger her again.

Himawari is a cheerful upbeat girl. She enjoys drawing things, particularly her family, cooking, and playing with others. She is shown to be very close to her parents' friends and their respective family, such as referring to Sakura as "aunt" and likewise Sarada calls her "Hima-chan". She has picked up her father's trait of referring to others with nicknames, such as when she referred to Orochimaru as "Oro-chan". Much like her grandfather Minato, she is very patience and humble, able to remain calm under dangerous situations and push herself to help others. She is also very kind and considerate. This extends to strangers, having given up her much-desired Kurama toy to a boy, believing that he needed it more than her. Likewise, she shows a strong affinity towards animals, able to approach most wild beasts calmly and with acceptance from them.

Despite naive and curious about many things with life like most children her age, Himawari also shows a noticeable mature and responsible nature for her age. She regularly aids her mother in the various household chores and has a strong commitment to whatever task is presented to her. She is quite considerate about her own future; while many expect her to become a kunoichi due to her lineage, she has decided to experience various career paths to determine her own goals. As mentioned by Iruka Umino, she possesses the same stubbornness that her father possesses, being somewhat boisterous and hyperactive as she is determined in never giving up on a goal even with faced with difficulty.
